title: Cyclic groups and generators
section: Part B: Abstract Algebra ▷ Cyclic Groups

If a subgroup contained any a with k > 0, it would also contain a , which is outside P
because a has infinite order. Thus only the identity can occur. Nonnegative powers form a
cancellative monoid, but do not form the entire infinite cyclic group.

question.text:
How many ordered pairs of elements generate the Klein four-group V ?
4
(A) 3 (B) 4 (C) 6 (D) 8 (E) 12

solution.text:
The first element must be one of the three nonidentity elements, and the second must be
a different nonidentity element, giving two choices. Such a pair generates both elements,
their distinct product, and the identity. An identity or repeated element generates at most
a subgroup of order two, so the count is 3 · 2 = 6.
